name: Naturschutzstiftung Niederrhein: Fördermittel
summary: Small grants, usually under EUR 2,000, for local conservation projects such as wildflower meadows, bat roosts, orchard meadows and wild bee support. Individuals and associations apply in writing; the foundation advises contacting its board first.
